description: This Java source file defines a utility class for managing watch face configuration data on an Android Wear device. It contains methods for fetching, overwriting, and publishing configuration data via the Wearable Data Layer API, as well as constants for color settings and paths used for data synchronization.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods and constants for managing watch face configuration data such as colors and sync operations using the Wearable Data Layer API.

methods.name: parseColor
methods.description: Converts a color name string into an ARGB color int using Android's Color.parseColor.

methods.name: fetchConfigDataMap
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current DataMap configuration from the wearable device and passes it to a callback.

methods.name: overwriteKeysInConfigDataMap
methods.description: Fetches the current config DataMap, then overwrites specified keys with new values, updating the DataItem.

methods.name: putConfigDataItem
methods.description: Creates or updates the DataItem with the provided configuration DataMap.
